program.name: Proposed therapeutic tai chi fall-prevention course

scope.counterfactual: Existing six-week Sun-style classes continue; the gift funds a new 24-week TJQMBB course.

classesPerCourse.label: Classes per course
classesPerCourse.rationale: 24 weeks x 2 classes, per the trial protocol.

sources.title: Therapeutic tai ji quan randomized trial

paidHoursPerClass.label: Paid instructor preparation and delivery hours per class
paidHoursPerClass.rationale: SF planning assumption: one hour delivery plus one hour preparation/travel.

hypothesizedEndpointUtility.label: Hypothesized endpoint utility gain versus stretching
hypothesizedEndpointUtility.rationale: Independent calibration of .04. The source table labels .04 as incremental QALYs while its prose describes a utility difference; reading it as integrated QALYs would lower the price 4x. Unit ambiguity is unresolved.

horizonYears.label: Modeled follow-up horizon
horizonYears.rationale: Rounded six-month horizon; no persistence beyond follow-up.

onsetFraction.label: Average fraction of endpoint benefit realized over follow-up
onsetFraction.rationale: 0.5 assumes linear growth from zero to endpoint.

instructorHourlyCost.label: Loaded instructor cost per paid hour
instructorHourlyCost.rationale: SF assumed $60/hour paid preparation and delivery; spread is analyst judgment, not wage data.

supportCostPerParticipant.label: Licensing, room, outreach and screening cost per participant
supportCostPerParticipant.rationale: Licensing, room and screening allowance; not priced.

localTransfer.label: Local fidelity and population retention of the trial effect
localTransfer.rationale: Proposed curriculum, high-risk recruitment and realistic local alternatives; reference is stretching.

additionality.label: Share of funded places that are net-new capacity
additionality.rationale: Assumed net added places after replacement funding; no verified offer.

participantsPerCourse.label: Enrolled participants per course
participantsPerCourse.rationale: SF assumed occupancy; no provider cap verified.

nativeOutcome.unit: additional fidelity-equivalent high-risk participants completing a 24-week course

outcomesPer10kUsd.unit: additional fidelity-equivalent high-risk participants completing a 24-week course per $10,000

costPerOutcome.unit: USD per additional fidelity-equivalent high-risk participants completing a 24-week course

qalysPerNativeOutcome.unit: QALYs per additional fidelity-equivalent high-risk participants completing a 24-week course

qalyLayer.notes: probabilityNonPositive is 0 by construction: v1 input distributions are strictly positive, so the null case lives only in nullBoundary.

simulation.notes: Inputs drawn independently. Legacy SF scenarios were joint corners; independent draws give a narrower price spread than those corners.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: Named curriculum, qualified instructors, high-risk eligibility and an active cohort budget.

nullBoundary: Null or harm remains possible. Zero additionality or a non-fidelity course gives no finite price.

sessions.evidence: Legacy model data/san-francisco/selfhelp-falls-cea-v1.json; interval not recorded in data/research-effort.json. Factoring into this template: open-botec design session 2026-10-18.
